parallels.note: She conceived, and bore a son; and he named him Er.
She conceived again, and bore a son; and she named him Onan.

people.name: Maher-shalal-hash-baz
people.line: Symbolic name given to Isaiah's son, meaning "swift is booty, speedy is prey."

translations.web: I went to the prophetess, and she conceived, and bore a son. Then Yahweh said to me, “Call his name ‘Maher Shalal Hash Baz.’
translations.bsb: And I had relations with the prophetess, and she conceived and gave birth to a son. The LORD said to me, “Name him Maher-shalal-hash-baz.
translations.kjv: And I went unto the prophetess; and she conceived, and bare a son. Then said the LORD to me, Call his name Mahershalalhashbaz.
translations.asv: And I went unto the prophetess; and she conceived, and bare a son. Then said Jehovah unto me, Call his name Maher-shalal-hash-baz.
